faq.title: Promocode FAQ and Savings Questions
faq.description: Detailed answers about how promocodes work, how long they last, and how PromoBozor verifies savings for users in Uzbekistan.

questions.question: How do I use a promocode?
questions.answer: Using a promocode is simple and involves 3 easy steps. First, find the promocode you need on our site and click the 'Copy' button. The code will be automatically copied to your clipboard. Then, navigate to the store or service website - for example, Yandex Eats, Uzum, Click, or Payme. Once you've filled your shopping cart and proceed to checkout, you'll find a designated field labeled 'promocode', 'coupon', 'promo code', 'kupon', or 'code' on the payment page. Paste the code you copied from us into this field and click the 'Apply' button. If the code is valid and active, the discount will be automatically calculated and reflected in your total. Note: some stores may apply promocodes only to specific product categories or require a minimum purchase amount. You can find the terms and conditions for each promocode on our site. According to our verification, most verified promocodes worked successfully in 2024.

questions.question: How long are promocodes valid?
questions.answer: Each promocode has its own validity period determined by the store or service. The expiration date is clearly displayed on the promocode page. Some promocodes are valid indefinitely with no expiration date, but most are valid for 1-4 weeks, 1-3 months, or for limited-time special events. Once a promocode expires, it will no longer work and the discount will not be applied. That's why it's important to check the expiration date before using it. Our site clearly shows the expiration date for each promocode, and expired promocodes are automatically marked as 'expired'. Additionally, some stores may require using a promocode within a specific timeframe, such as within 24 hours of activation. In such cases, detailed information is provided in the promocode description.

questions.question: Are promocodes free?
questions.answer: Yes, all promocodes are completely free. Using PromoBozor requires no payment whatsoever. Our mission is to find the best discounts for Uzbekistan users and compile them in one place. You don't pay anything to copy, use, or receive discounts from promocodes. We partner with stores and brands, but this comes at no additional cost to you. Unlike some sites, we don't require registration, collect personal information, or impose other conditions. We strive to make finding, accessing, and using promocodes as easy and convenient as possible. If you have questions, you can reach us via Telegram.

questions.question: What should I do if a promocode doesn't work?
questions.answer: If a promocode doesn't work, first check its expiration date. Expired codes won't work. If the date hasn't passed, ensure you've entered the code correctly - some are case-sensitive. Also, read the promocode terms - there may be restrictions like minimum purchase amount, specific categories, or new customers only. If everything seems correct but the code still doesn't work, we recommend contacting the store's customer service. Also, please notify us - we'll verify and update or remove the promocode if needed. We rely on our users to help maintain promocode quality and resolve issues within 24 hours. You can reach us through our Telegram channel or the 'Report' button on the page.

questions.question: How often are new promocodes added?
questions.answer: We add new promocodes every day and regularly update existing ones. Our team monitors daily the latest offers from the most popular stores and services in Uzbekistan. Yandex Eats, Uzum, Click, Payme, and other platforms announce new discounts and promotions daily, and we add them to our site immediately. Before special events and holidays - such as Navruz, Independence Day, or New Year - the number of promocodes increases significantly. To stay informed about the latest offers, check our site regularly or subscribe to our Telegram channel. We also create dedicated pages for popular stores where all current promocodes are collected.

verification.title: How We Verify Promocodes Before Publishing
verification.description: Learn how PromoBozor reviews sources, checks validity, confirms conditions, and refreshes promocodes before they appear on the site.
verification.heroDescription: We treat each offer like editorial content: source review, manual checks, terms validation and ongoing freshness monitoring for shoppers in Uzbekistan.
verification.stepsDescription: Every public offer goes through the same repeatable review process before it is labelled as active on PromoBozor.

steps.title: Source collection
steps.description: We collect offers from official brand pages, app screens, newsletters and campaign landing pages relevant to Uzbekistan.

steps.title: Manual validation
steps.description: We review discount details, entry conditions, eligible products and whether the offer applies to local shoppers.

steps.title: Freshness check
steps.description: We confirm start dates, expiry windows and whether the promocode or deal link is still visible on the source page.

steps.title: Editorial publish
steps.description: Only clear, understandable offers with enough context are published with title, discount amount and usage conditions.

steps.title: Ongoing cleanup
steps.description: Expired, misleading or duplicated deals are edited or removed as soon as we confirm they are no longer useful.

verification.standardsDescription: We prefer fewer high-quality offers over publishing low-confidence codes.

standards.title: Clear savings value
standards.description: The discount amount, bonus or benefit must be understandable before a shopper clicks through.

standards.title: Usable conditions

standards.title: Local relevance
standards.description: We prioritize offers that work for shoppers in Uzbekistan and match the store's local checkout flow.
